org.invite.title: Invite user
org.invite.description: Invite someone by email. They join with the role you choose.
org.invite.roleHint: Pick the role that fits the person; add more roles only when they need them.
org.invite.outsideBadge: They are marked as outside your organization wherever members are listed.
org.invite.stepUpNote: You will confirm your identity when you send: this role is above member.
org.invite.mfaNote: They must use two-factor authentication to open the organization.
org.invite.ssoExceptionNote: Your organization enforces single sign-on: an owner must add them as an SSO exception so they can sign in.
org.invite.accessEndsOptionalHint: Leave empty to keep access until you remove them.
org.invite.accessEndsRequiredHint: Your organization requires an end date for people outside it: {days} days if you leave it empty.
org.invite.createdBody: {email} joins after opening the invitation link. When email is configured they also receive it by email.
org.invite.lookalikeBody: {email} reaches the same mailbox as {others}. Check that this is not the same person with a second account.
org.invite.outsideJoined: {email} is outside your organization and is marked as such.
org.invite.shownOnceBody: Anyone with this link can join as {email}. It will not be shown again; cancel the invitation and invite again if it is lost.
org.invite.code.INVITEE_NOT_ON_VERIFIED_: Your organization invites only addresses on its verified domains.
org.invite.code.INVITEE_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOW: Your organization invites only addresses on its verified or allowed domains.
org.invite.code.PERSONAL_ACCOUNTS_BLOCKE: Your organization does not accept personal email addresses.
org.invite.code.ABOVE_TRUST_CEILING: The trust with this person's organization does not allow this role.
org.invite.code.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member.
org.invite.code.ALREADY_INVITED: This person already has a pending invitation.
org.invite.code.ROLE_NOT_GRANTABLE: One of these roles cannot be given.
org.invite.code.ADMIN_NEEDS_OWNER: Only the owner can make someone an administrator.
org.invite.code.INVITATIONS_RATE_LIMITED: You sent many invitations in the last hour. Try again later.
org.invite.code.generic: The invitation could not be created. Try again.
org.invitations.mfaHint: The role is above member for someone outside the organization: they must use two-factor authentication.
org.invitations.resendTooSoon: This invitation was sent recently. Wait a few minutes before sending it again.
org.invitePolicy.title: Who can be invited
org.invitePolicy.description: Applies when an invitation is sent and when it is accepted. People outside your organization are always marked as such.
org.invitePolicy.anyHint: Any email address, including personal ones and other companies' domains.
org.invitePolicy.verified_domainsHint: Only addresses on the domains your organization has verified.
org.invitePolicy.allow_listHint: Verified domains plus the allowed email domains below. Add an allowed domain to use this.
org.invitePolicy.endRequired: Require an end of access for people outside
org.invitePolicy.endRequiredHint: For outside people no organization manages (for example personal addresses): 90 days by default, 365 at most.
org.roleTemplate.updateBody: The {template} template changed since this role was created from it (version {from} to {to}). Your role does not change until you apply the update.
org.roleTemplate.keepsEdits: Your own changes to the role are kept. Full data access is never changed by an update.
org.acceptInvite.acceptedBody: This invitation has already been accepted.
org.acceptInvite.acceptFailed: The invitation could not be accepted.
org.acceptInvite.declineBody: You will not join {org}. The person who invited you can send a new invitation later.
org.acceptInvite.declinedBody: You declined the invitation to {org}. Nothing was shared with the organization.
org.acceptInvite.declineFailed: The invitation could not be declined. Try again.
org.acceptInvite.expiredBody: This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
org.acceptInvite.incomplete: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the link from your invitation email again.
org.acceptInvite.loadFailed: The invitation could not be loaded. Try again.
org.acceptInvite.mfaOutside: You will set up two-factor authentication before you can open {org}: your roles are privileged and you are outside the organization.
org.acceptInvite.mfaPolicy: {org} requires two-factor authentication: you will set it up before you can open it.
org.acceptInvite.newHere: New here? Create an account for {email}, then accept the invitation.
org.acceptInvite.noAccessEnd: Your access has no end date.
org.acceptInvite.noTeams: No teams yet. You will see data once a team includes you.
org.acceptInvite.noTeamsFullData: No teams. Your role sees all of the organization's data.
org.acceptInvite.notFound: Invitation not found or has expired.
org.acceptInvite.otherAccount: Sign in with a different account
org.acceptInvite.outside: You join from outside {org}. Members see an External badge next to your name.
org.acceptInvite.subtitle: {name} invited you to join {org}.
org.acceptInvite.title: Invitation
org.invite.teams.hint: Optional. Teams give access to their assets and findings. Without a team, a member who does not see all data sees nothing.
org.invite.teams.label: Teams
org.invite.teams.none: This organization has no teams yet.
org.invite.code.TEAM_NOT_GRANTABLE: You cannot add people to one of these teams.
org.ownership.dialog.title: Transfer ownership
org.ownership.dialog.description: Ask {name} to become the owner of this organization. Nothing changes until they accept, within 72 hours, after signing in again.
org.ownership.check.title: The new owner must be
org.ownership.previousRole.label: After the transfer, you become
org.ownership.previousRole.hint: Your custom roles and teams stay. Only the owner can delete the organization, make administrators and change security settings.
org.ownership.outsider.notice: {name} is outside the organization and no organization manages their address. When they accept, they become an internal member and their end of access is removed.
org.ownership.outsider.confirm: I confirm that {name} becomes an internal member
org.ownership.banner.newOwnerTitle: {name} asked you to become the owner
org.ownership.banner.newOwnerBody: As the owner you can delete the organization, make administrators and change its security settings. {from} becomes {role}. You will sign in again to accept. The request expires on {date}.
org.ownership.banner.ownerBody: Nothing changes until they accept. When they do, you become {role}. The request expires on {date}.
org.ownership.banner.becomesInternal: You also become an internal member: your end of access is removed.
org.ownership.confirm.acceptDesc: You will be asked to sign in again. You become the owner and {from} becomes {role}.
org.ownership.confirm.declineDesc: {from} stays the owner and is told that you declined.
org.ownership.confirm.cancelDesc: You stay the owner. {name} is told that the request was canceled.
org.ownership.blocker.inactive: Only an active member can become the owner.
org.ownership.blocker.managed: Another organization manages this person, so they cannot become the owner.
org.ownership.blocker.mfa: They must turn on two-factor authentication first.
org.ownership.error.notOwner: Only the owner can transfer ownership.
org.ownership.error.pending: A transfer is already waiting for an answer. Cancel it first.
org.ownership.error.notFound: This transfer is no longer open.
org.ownership.error.expired: This transfer has expired. Ask the owner for a new one.
org.ownership.error.void: The person who asked is no longer the owner, so this transfer is void.
org.ownership.blocker.service: A service account cannot own an organization.
org.ownership.error.confirmInternal: Confirm that this person becomes an internal member.
org.ownership.error.previousRole: Choose administrator, member or viewer for yourself.
org.invite.code.LIMIT_REACHED: The organization's limit is reached (seats or invitations a day).
org.createTeam.urlNotAvailable: This URL is not available. Choose another one.
org.onboarding.verifyFirst: Verify your email address to see the organizations you can join. Check your inbox for the link.
org.onboarding.yourCompanyDesc: This organization verified your email domain and lets colleagues join.
org.onboarding.waitingHint: The organization's administrators have your request. You will get an email when they decide.
org.onboarding.unavailable: This offer is no longer available. The list was refreshed.
org.onboarding.failed: Could not complete this step. Try again.
org.onboarding.createFirstDesc: A team is your workspace for managing exposure across an organisation. You can invite teammates after this.
org.onboarding.createAnotherDesc: A new team is its own workspace. You can switch between teams from the sidebar at any time.
org.onboarding.adminCreatesTitle: Organizations are created by your administrator
org.onboarding.adminCreatesDesc: On this installation only the platform administrator can create organizations. Ask them to create the organization you need.
org.onboarding.noOrgTitle: You are not a member of any organization yet
org.onboarding.noOrgDesc: Ask your administrator to add you to an organization or to send you an invitation. If you received an invitation email, open its link to join.
org.joinRequests.title: Requests to join ({count})
org.joinRequests.desc: People with a verified address on your domain who asked to join. Nobody becomes an administrator by request.
org.leave.title: Leave this organization
org.leave.desc: You lose access to this organization at once. Your account and your other organizations are kept. The only owner cannot leave.
org.leave.confirmDesc: Your access ends now and your API keys for this organization are revoked. An administrator can invite you again later.
org.leave.soleOwner: Transfer ownership to another member first.
org.region.new: Data region: {region}. It is fixed for the organization once created.
org.roles.teamRoleNote: This is a team role. It is the member’s role in the organization, so it changes on the Members page, and ownership moves with Transfer ownership.
org.roles.teamRoleUnavailable: This team role cannot be changed here
org.roles.manageNote: Custom roles add permissions on top of the role in the organization.
org.roles.ownerLocked: This person is the owner. Ownership moves with Transfer ownership.
org.access.title: Access restrictions
org.access.desc: Enforced for user accounts in this organization. Sensors, API keys and the platform admin console are not affected.
org.access.domainsPlaceholder:
One domain per line
Example: example.com
org.access.domainsHelp: When set, only people whose email is at one of these domains can be invited, added by an administrator, or join through single sign-on. Existing members are not removed.
org.access.domainsEmpty: Empty: any email domain is allowed.
org.access.ipPlaceholder:
IP addresses or CIDR ranges, one per line
Example: 192.168.1.0/24
org.access.ipHelp: When set, users can only use this organization from these addresses; requests from anywhere else are refused. The check uses the IP address the server sees: behind a VPN, proxy or NAT that is the address of that gateway, not your device.
org.access.lockout: Saving it would lock you out. Include your current IP (or a range containing it), or leave the list empty.
org.auth.saveFailed: Could not save the sign-in settings
org.auth.title: Authentication
org.auth.desc: How people sign in to this organization, and who may join.
org.auth.email.autoHint: Require verification when the platform can send email
org.auth.email.alwaysHint: Require verification (the platform must be able to send email)
org.auth.email.neverHint: Accounts count as verified at registration: closed deployments only
org.auth.ownerOnly: Only the organization owner can change these settings.
org.auth.mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
org.auth.mfa.desc: Members who sign in through SSO use your identity provider's two-factor settings.
org.auth.mfa.allHint: Members who sign in with a password set up an authenticator app at their next sign-in.
org.auth.mfa.ssoProofHint: For members who must use two-factor, a sign-in through your identity provider counts only when the provider confirms a second factor in the signed sign-in response. Turn on multi-factor authentication in your identity provider first.
org.auth.mfa.adminsHint: They can change the organization, so they use an authenticator app even when other members do not. On for new organizations.
org.auth.newMembers.title: New members
org.auth.newMembers.desc: What happens when someone joins for the first time.
org.auth.jitHint: People your SSO admits for the first time wait, with no access, until an administrator approves them in Members.
org.auth.email.title: Email verification
org.auth.email.desc: Whether new accounts must verify their email address before signing in.
org.auth.email.neverWarning: Anyone can register with any email address, which allows account takeover through spoofed addresses. Use it only where registration is restricted by other means.
org.auth.sensorMoved: What scan jobs may do on your sensors is set in
org.auth.loosen.title: Weaken sign-in security?
org.auth.loosen.desc: These changes make the organization easier to get into. The owner and administrators are told, and the change is recorded in the audit log.

org.storage.title: Storage provider
org.storage.desc: Where uploaded evidence and attachments are stored.
org.storage.localHelp: Files are stored on the server disk at the default storage path.
org.storage.keysHelp: The stored keys are never shown. Leave both empty to keep them.
org.storage.switchNote: Files already stored stay readable after a switch: each file remembers which provider holds it.
org.general.saveFailed: Could not save the organization settings
org.general.title: General
org.general.desc: Your organization's name, logo and file storage, and the owner's danger zone.
org.general.profileDesc: How your organization is named and recognised.
org.general.logoUnreadable: That image could not be read
org.general.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, shown at up to 200 × 200 px
org.general.logoWillRemove: The logo is removed when you save.
org.general.logoWillReplace: The new logo is used when you save.
org.general.logoLocked: Only administrators can change the logo.
org.general.name: Organization name
org.general.slugHelpOwner: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it breaks saved links, and it cannot change while single sign-on is configured.
org.general.slugHelpLocked: Only the owner can change the URL.
org.danger.transferDesc: Make another member the owner. You choose your new role; the new owner must accept. Open the member in Members and choose Transfer ownership.
org.danger.deleteDesc: Closes the organization for everyone now and deletes it with everything in it after 14 days: assets, findings, scans, members, roles, settings and its audit log. An owner can cancel until then. Member accounts are kept.
org.auth.loosen.mfaOff: Two-factor authentication is no longer required for everyone.
org.auth.loosen.mfaAdminsOff: Owners and administrators no longer need two-factor authentication.
org.auth.loosen.ipEmptied: The IP allowlist is emptied: every network may connect.
org.auth.loosen.ipWidened: The IP allowlist allows more networks.
org.auth.loosen.emailNever: Email addresses are no longer verified.
org.auth.loosen.jitOff: New SSO members get access without approval.
org.auth.loosen.ssoMfaProofOff: Your identity provider no longer has to confirm a second factor.
org.auth.loosen.ssoExceptionAdded: More members may sign in without single sign-on.
org.auth.loosen.externalEndOff: External members no longer need an end date.
org.personal.title: Personal accounts
org.personal.desc: People with a personal email address (gmail.com, outlook.com, ...) belong to no organization. They join only by invitation, as viewers with no data, and their access always ends.
org.personal.allowed_with_mfaDesc: They can be invited, and must prove a second factor every time they sign in.
org.personal.allowedDesc: They can be invited and sign in like anyone else.
org.personal.blockedDesc: They cannot be invited, and existing ones cannot open the organization. Nothing is deleted.
org.personal.exceptionsDesc: SSO is required in this organization. These members may sign in without it, with a second factor, until the date shown (at most {days} days).
org.personal.reasonPlaceholder: Contractor without an account in our identity provider
org.sso.managedTitle: SSO is configured by your platform administrator
org.sso.managedText: {what} is set up for your organization in the platform administration console. To add or change it, contact your platform administrator.
org.sso.title: Single sign-on
org.sso.noticeText: Single sign-on (SAML or OIDC), with verified domains, is set up for your organization in the platform administration console. To add or change it, contact your platform administrator.
org.danger.scheduledHint: It is closed to everyone now. An owner can cancel the deletion from the sign-in page until then.
org.dashboardData.title: Dashboard data
org.dashboardData.description: Dashboard numbers are computed from stored per-asset data, kept current from every change and checked every night. Rebuild it if dashboards look wrong.
org.dashboardData.requested: Rebuild requested. Dashboards update when it finishes.
org.dashboardData.tooSoon: Dashboard data can be rebuilt once per hour.
org.dashboardData.loadFailed: Could not load dashboard data status
org.dashboardData.notBuilt: Not built yet: the first build runs in the background.
org.dashboardData.pending: Rebuild requested; it starts within a few minutes.
org.lifecycle.serviceAccountKeysNote: Keys this member minted for service accounts. They are revoked when the member is offboarded or loses the administrator role.
org.lifecycle.offboarded: {name} offboarded: {keys} key(s) revoked, {serviceKeys} service account key(s) revoked, {groups} group(s) removed
org.membersPage.peerAdminLock: Only the organization owner can change, disable or offboard an administrator.
org.membersPage.resetMfaOwnerOnly: Only the organization owner can reset the two-factor authentication of an owner or administrator.
org.membersPage.title: Members
org.membersPage.description: People in this organization, their roles and pending invitations.
org.membersPage.loadFailedBody: The member list could not be loaded.

org.rolesPage.emptyBody: Create a role to grant a set of permissions to users.
org.teamsPage.title: Teams
org.teamsPage.teamsDesc: Organize members into teams to control which assets they can see. What members can do comes from their roles.
org.teamsPage.rulesDesc: Rules that assign assets to teams automatically, evaluated in priority order.
org.teams.loadFailedBody: The team list could not be loaded.
org.teams.emptyBody: Create a team to group users and scope their access to assets.
org.teams.noTeamNote: Members who are in no team see no assets or findings until you add them to a team or grant them an asset. Owners, admins and roles with full data access see everything.
org.teams.createDesc: Create a new team to organize users and control access to assets.
org.teams.descPlaceholder: Describe the purpose of this team...

org.assignmentRules.emptyBody: Rules route new findings to teams automatically, in priority order.

org.assignmentRules.name: Name
org.assignmentRules.namePlaceholder: e.g., Critical assets to Security team
org.assignmentRules.conditionsHint: Assets matching these conditions will be automatically assigned to the target team.
org.roleSheet.createDesc: Create a custom role with specific permissions
org.roleSheet.templateHint: Least-privilege starting points for the people in a CTEM program. You can only save permissions you hold yourself.
org.roleSheet.descPlaceholder: Describe what this role can do...
org.roleSheet.fullDataHint: Access all data regardless of team membership
org.roleAddMember.failed: Failed to add members to role

org.roleAddMember.desc: Select members to add to the "{role}" role.
org.roleAddMember.allHave: All members already have this role
org.roleCaps.unavailable: The authorization reference is not available in this build.
org.roleCaps.adminBypass: Owners and administrators pass every permission check.
org.roleCaps.intro: Actions this role’s permissions allow, by feature. Teams still decide which assets it sees, and a disabled module hides the feature.
org.ruleDetail.inactiveBody: It does not route new findings until it is activated.
org.addUser.addedBody: {who} can sign in after setting a password.
org.addUser.title: Add user
org.addUser.desc: Create an account for someone in your organization. They get a link to set their password.
org.addUser.name: Name
org.addUser.rolesHint: Roles define what this user can do (up to {max}).
org.teamRoles.intro: Every member holds these roles while in the team, and loses them on leaving it.
org.teamRoles.emptyDesc: Members hold only their own roles.
org.teamRoles.privilegedHint: Grants an administrator-level permission: only an owner changes this team
org.teamRoles.fullDataHint: Members see every asset; external members and service accounts cannot join
org.roleTemplate.confirmDesc: It adds {added} permissions and removes {removed} for everyone who holds this role. Your own changes to the role are kept. Applying it cannot be reversed here; you can edit the role afterwards.
org.roleAddMember.confirmDesc: They get every permission this role has ({permissions} permissions) at once, and the change is recorded in the audit log. You can remove them from the role later.
org.scopeRules.reconciled: Reconciled: {rules} rules evaluated, {added} assets added, {removed} removed
org.lifecycle.offboardDesc: Their access ends permanently: API keys are revoked and their access groups, grants, pentest engagements and roles are removed. Their membership stays as a record so history keeps their name; inviting them again later starts from zero. To pause access instead, disable them. You will be asked to verify it's you.
org.lifecycle.handOver: Hand their work to someone else
org.lifecycle.stillNeedsOwner: Something still needs a new owner
org.lifecycle.holdingsChanged: {categories}. Their holdings changed while this dialog was open; choose a new owner and try again.

org.memberAccess.hint: At most {days} days from today. A member whose access ended is enabled again.
